title: Stale QA walk alarm
current: The stale sweep aborts an active or walking QA execution after 30 minutes without a walk heartbeat or tool call from the owner or its subagents unless its live owner is parked. At 20 silent minutes the same sweep sends the live, unparked owner one Fleet message per silence (idempotency key qa-walk-silent:<execution>:<activity_at>) naming the execution, item, Test Machine, abort time, yoke qa mission host-command and the host release command. sessions.list rows carry silent_walks (execution, item, Test Machine, heartbeat_at, activity_at); the fleet watcher emits one urgent fleet ALARM stale-walk execution=<id> item=<ref> host=<machine> silent=<N>m session=<id> line and one fleet CLEAR stale-walk line when activity resumes or the walk ends. An owner that already has an idle-holder line carries stale_walk=<id>:<N>m on that line instead, and that line reprints when the walk joins it. An older server without activity_at uses the walk heartbeat for its inactivity clock. An older server without silent_walks raises no stale-walk line.
